sup:70110.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. For many years, our family foundry has taken great pride in supplying your respected company with high-quality castings from our region, and we value our long standing relationship very much.

Our team has prepared our offer carefully. We can offer you a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

To remain transparent about our situation, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. We trust that you understand the necessity of these figures for our ongoing operation and quality standards.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Your letter gives 51 days' notice (doc:20260911-70110-P01), while our framework agreement requires 90 days (ctr:4600070110#3.1).
Our bottom-up cost model puts the full cost of this part at EUR 132.64 per unit (cost:310010).
Producer prices DE: electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -6.1% from 2025-11 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-11, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).

Please find our proposal below.
If faster payment helps you, we are open to it, as shown in the packages.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Our family foundry values the long relationship between our companies, and we appreciate your thoroughness. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the notice period data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. As to the index change and should cost and notice period data you cited, we did not know that - a fair point. We have carefully reviewed your data regarding the energy index and your cost model, and we respect your thoroughness. We appreciate your offer of 14-day payment terms, which we have incorporated into our revised proposal.

LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. That remains. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Our costs move with LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351; the figures stay with us. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.

In consideration of these points and the notice period, we are prepared to adjust our price to €134.00 per unit for an implementation on 2026-11-01. Our offer presents a price of €134.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 November 2026. This Angebot stays valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

As to the delivery record data you cited, we did not know that - a fair point. We have reviewed the delivery scorecard data you provided; as a family foundry that prides itself on reliability, we take this seriously and are addressing it. 

We appreciate your continued offer of 14-day payment terms. In light of your verified data, we are prepared to adjust our price to €131.20 per unit. 

Our current Angebot consists of a price of €131.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 November 2026. Our Lieferzeit is 42 days. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We value the long relationship between our companies and look forward to continuing our work together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
